name: 97211 · Portland, OR
findings: ZIP 97211 (Portland) has 206 nonprofit organizations. 98 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 79 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 97211 (Portland) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
47% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 97211 (Portland) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.1 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 47 organizations here; 58% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
